name: CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2024
information:
This is the Mid-Atlantic championship, but anyone can compete regardless of whether they live in the Mid-Atlantic Region or not. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MidAtlanticChampionship2024#45321-championship-eligibility) tab.

This event will take place on the arena side of the Henrico Sports & Events Center. Please note that outside food and beverage is not permitted inside the facility.
